message.content: The incident has been escalated to you for a human decision because the severity score of 4.0 falls within 0.25 of a band threshold [F02][F05][F03]. The breach involves up to 310 data subjects and sensitive categories including bank account details, names, PESEL, and salary [F04][F02]. Unauthorised access was reported by the processor, and the data was not rendered unintelligible because encryption keys were provider-managed [F03][F05]. Based on GDPR Art. 33(1) and Art. 34(1), the provisional decision is to notify the supervisory authority and the affected individuals.
